title: Oracle Streaming Task / Idea / Gap
description: Cross-domain backlog entry. Any agent or human may create one. Adopted from the SISO org .tasks convention (SISO_Internal_Lab/.tasks), extended with ui/security categories + a domain tag so UI ideas, security gaps, and future work live in ONE registry.

status.description: Lifecycle stage. New ideas/gaps start as 'backlog'.

domain.description: Which part of the project this belongs to. Drives the hub Backlog-tab grouping.

category.description: Type. 'idea' = maybe-someday, 'gap' = a found-but-unbuilt surface, 'feature' = committed work.

target_agent.description: Which agent/lane should handle this (optional until triaged).

created_by.description: 'human' (Shaan) or the agent name that logged it.

evidence.description: file:line proof or the source audit that backs this. Reconcile against PROVEN-LEDGER before flagging a gap (cold agents 'discover' things that already exist).

verified.description: Has a second pass confirmed this is real (not a false alarm)? Unverified items are candidates, not facts.
